about: Recipes the deploy ships that no list row holds: read by the engine beside the account's own recipe rows and never written; restored one to one from Trillion-X records/workflow-recipe-records.json (workflow:hand-to-an-agent).

payload.label: Hand it to one of your AIs
payload.job: Hand something that just arrived or was asked for (a note, a voice memo, an email, a message, a comment, a button pressed in the app) to one of the person's AIs, with the job in plain words and every detail of what arrived; the AI named in to_agent takes it, or whichever takes it first when none is named, and what that AI did is kept as the result. One item (once_per) is handed off once, however many rules or runs hand it.

job.description: What the AI should do with what arrived, in plain words

arrived.description: Every detail of what arrived: where from, when, who, the ids to read it by

to_agent.description: The agent_id of the one AI that should take it; leave it out for whichever of the person's AIs takes it first

said.description: The work as the person sees it on their notifications and AI work, in their own words or a plain title; never a tool name or instructions to an AI

once_per.description: The identity of the one item this is about (a message id, an event id): everything handed off for the same item is one job, whichever rule or run hands it

case_id.description: The decision the AI works this through, when the item has one

priority.description: How soon it is taken, 0 to 9, higher first: what the person said themselves goes ahead of information that arrived for them
